character: A high alpine village strung along the Great Alpine Road on the Mt Hotham ridge in Victoria, known as an 'upside-down' mountain because the village sits near the top and many runs drop below it. It is owned by Vail Resorts and included without day limits on the Epic Pass; Dinner Plain nearby offers more lodging.
learning: Reference note: beginner areas sit near the summit and village (the Summit Trainer carpet ran on opening weekend 2026); confirm 2027 lesson products.

source.note: Winter 2026: resort announcement 'Sunday 6 September will be our last day of skiing and boarding for winter' (search summary; exact news page not captured). Opening: operating from Sat 6 Jun 2026 with the Summit Trainer carpet (https://snowbrains.com/australia-ski-season-2026-opening-weekend-perisher-thredbo-buller-falls-hotham/). skiresort.info had listed a tentative 6 Jun – 4 Oct 2026 season. Official homepage (read 2026-10-03): "1 September - ... our final day of skiing and boarding for winter will be Sunday 6 September"; "6 September - That's a wrap on winter at Hotham."

season.typicalText: The season traditionally starts on the King's Birthday long weekend in early June (6 Jun 2026) and was scheduled to run to early October; in the very poor 2026 season the last day was 6 Sep.
season.notes: Southern Hemisphere: Piste season id 2026-27 is the June–October 2027 winter (the one the 2026-27 Ikon and Epic passes cover); 2025-26 is the 2026 winter and 2024-25 the 2025 winter. No 2027 opening or closing date was found as of 2026-09-30. Australian resorts traditionally open on the King's Birthday long weekend — in 2027 that is Sat 12 – Mon 14 June (calendar inference, not an announcement). Victorian alpine resorts charge a resort entry fee (reference). skiresort.com lists the next season as 05.06.2027 – 12.09.2027 (third-party listing, not an announcement).
